motivation_not_cause_proof: Actual instrumented policy stream shows refresh13.66s of29.09s. It does not isolate SHA cost or prove full-dev bottleneck. Memoization is a hypothesis to qualify, not an accepted speedup.
fingerprint_key: Complete ordered immutable byte segments, exact tuple equality, never digest-only collision assumption, ID/token/GT/role or cached learned prototype
bounds_rule: Cache eviction only recomputes original exact SHA/numeric results. No state/version/parent/member pruning. Existing whole-support and actual RSS guards remain required.
process_rule: Only own-process FrameAtomicStateEMA hashlib alias and original input function aliases; global hashlib/reliability numeric hashes untouched; reject nesting/unknown aliases and restore on exceptions
